name: InboundEmails
technicalDescription: Every email received through a mailbox adapter (Gmail test label now, Outlook later), normalised by IngestEmail. Component 04 (פניות): Maya classifies (categories + quotes, senderRole), code verifies and routes and keeps handlingState (לא טופל / ממתין with waitingFor / טופל with handledBy). A reply linked through CIM-ref or threadId is stored with isThreadReply=true and opens no new ticket. Irrelevant mail keeps metadata only (bodyStored=false). Attachments and their extracted text live in EmailAttachments.

columns.description: Classification

columns.name: suggestedCustomerCode

columns.name: answeredAt
columns.description: When the reply was approved

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).

columns.name: bankLineId
columns.description: BankLines.bankLineId when this mail is the customer's reply to a detail request for that transfer (older data only: the detail request was removed on 08.11)

columns.name: categories
columns.description: All mail types Maya found, comma-separated, in folder order (1 כרטסת, 2 חובות פתוחים, 3 תעודות וחשבוניות חסרות, 4 הפרש מחיר, 5 פירוט תשלום, then הבטחת תשלום, אחר, לא רלוונטי). category holds the primary (first) one, which decides the folder

columns.name: senderRole
columns.description: Who wrote the mail

columns.name: verificationBasis
columns.description: Hebrew: what the verification rests on (registered contact X of customer Y / sales agent X authorized for customer Y / not registered)

columns.name: customerMatchMethod
columns.description: How the customer was identified

columns.name: mailboxId
columns.description: Mailboxes.id the mail arrived in (text link)

columns.name: handlingState
columns.description: Handling state shown on the inbox page. Default filter shows לא טופל + ממתין

columns.name: waitingFor
columns.description: When ממתין: for whom (e.g. ממתין ללוגיסטיקה: דני כהן / ממתין לאישור סוכן: X / ממתין להתאמת התקבול / ממתין ללקוח)

columns.name: waitingSince
columns.description: When the mail entered ממתין

columns.name: handledBy
columns.description: When טופל: who closed it (person display name, or מערכת for an automatic close)

columns.name: handledAt
columns.description: When it became טופל

columns.name: threadOf
columns.description: For a reply linked through the thread: Approvals.id of the outbound message it answers (text link)

columns.name: linkedTable
columns.description: Record this mail belongs to: BankLines, Disputes, InboundEmails, MailAutomationRuns

columns.name: linkedId
columns.description: Id of that record, as text (bankLineId, dispute id, inbound email id, run id)

columns.name: isThreadReply
columns.description: True when the mail was linked as a reply in an existing thread (CIM-ref or threadId) and opened no new ticket

columns.name: classifiedBy
columns.description: Who classified the mail

columns.name: classificationQuotes
columns.description: Maya's evidence: one quote per type and per invoice, verified by code; plus the customer candidates code gave her; promise = Maya's promise proposal awaiting approval (status ממתינה לאישור / אושרה, approvedPromiseId when approved in the email panel); dispute = a conditional payment or a claim the invoice is wrong, with the aging notes it opened
